prose: Axios reports that the US and China have created a 'Super Intelligence Dialogue' on AI risks and a separate AI incident hotline, likened to the Cold War-era red telephone between Washington and Moscow. The article is paywalled, so this summary is based on the headline and lead captured by the feed.
